title: File:Krabi, Limestone landscape, Thailand.jpg
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
description: Ancient limestone landscape of Krabi. The tower karst in Krabi is developed in massive Permian limestone and dolomitic limestone of the Ratburi Group. Two varieties of tower karst are prominent in the Krabi region, peak forest karst (isolated peaks) and peak cluster karst (group of peaks with a common rocky base). Krabi, Thailand.
